clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle sends an agent into the Venture Company’s mine. Explosives will draw the goblins away while the agent takes letters that reveal the company’s plans and help defend the Sentinels’ lands.

After the first blows against the Venture Company’s logging at Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle turns to the company’s supply heart. The plan follows the same pattern as before: an explosive diversion scatters goblin workers and mercenaries while an agent searches the mine for written orders and records.

At the eastern edge of Windshear Crag, Windshear Mine is the Venture Company’s base beneath the mountain. Its goblins dig for rock and cut timber, keeping records of supply routes and orders from their leaders. An agent slips inside, sets Gaxim’s explosive packs, and takes the Venture Co. Letters. The blast disrupts the mine’s guard, and the letters reveal more of the company’s plans in Kalimdor.

Gaxim takes pleasure in clever devices and explosions, but the work also matters to the night elves. In Stonetalon, the Sentinels face the Horde as well as the companies cutting and digging through their lands. Letters from the mine give commanders such as Kaela Shadowspear information they can use to anticipate threats to the sacred woods.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, friend.
We cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.
The key is to get their letters... Remember that.
The pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....

clips.title: Completion
paras: Incredible, friend! Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.
